basics.summary: Programme director with sixteen years in public health and humanitarian work. I turn complex funding and field realities into programmes that run on time, stay on budget and reach the people they are meant for.

experience.title: Programme Director
experience.description: Direct a portfolio of eleven health programmes across six countries with a combined budget of 18 million pounds.

bullets.text: Brought three programmes back on budget within nine months after a funding review.
Built a monitoring framework adopted by all eleven programme teams.
Negotiated two multi-year grants worth 6.5 million pounds in total.
Lead a leadership team of seven programme managers and two finance partners.
Present quarterly results to the board and to the three largest donors.

experience.title: Senior Programme Manager
experience.description: Managed the maternal health programme in West Africa.

bullets.text: Trained 1,200 community health workers in four regions.
Cut the reporting cycle from 90 to 45 days with a mobile data tool.
Opened a second field office and hired a team of 14.
Worked with ministries of health on national guidelines.

experience.title: Programme Manager
experience.description: Ran emergency response and recovery programmes after floods and storms.

bullets.text: Coordinated aid for 25,000 people after the 2015 winter floods.
Set up a volunteer network of 300 people ready to deploy within 48 hours.
Wrote the alliance's first safeguarding policy.
Reduced the cost per household supported by 20%.

experience.title: Project Officer
experience.description: Supported project teams with planning, budgets and reports.

bullets.text: Prepared monthly budget reports for eight projects.
Organised training days for 150 volunteers.
Wrote donor reports that secured two renewals.

experience.title: Policy Assistant
experience.description: Worked in the public health policy team.

bullets.text: Researched and summarised evidence for three local health strategies.
Drafted answers to public enquiries and councillor questions.
Helped organise a city-wide wellbeing survey with 4,000 responses.

experience.title: Research Intern
experience.description: Short placement during the final year of studies.

bullets.text: Interviewed 40 residents for a study on access to local services.
Prepared tables and charts for the trust's annual report.

education.notes: Graduated with distinction. Dissertation on community health workers in rural Ghana.

bullets.text: Introduced tablets and an offline reporting app to 160 clinics, replacing paper registers.
Wrote and field-tested a plain-language handbook now used in three countries.

achievements.text: Directed programmes reaching 2.1 million people across six countries.
Raised 6.5 million pounds in multi-year grants from institutional donors.
Built and led teams of up to 40 people across four time zones.
Introduced a monitoring framework now used by all eleven programmes at Helix.

volunteering.title: Trustee
volunteering.description: Served on the board of a food bank supporting 1,500 households a year.

bullets.text: Chaired the finance committee for three years.
Led a fundraising drive that raised 85,000 pounds.

volunteering.title: Mentor
volunteering.description: Mentor teenage girls in a weekly after-school coding club.

bullets.text: Run monthly sessions on careers in technology and health.

awards.name: Public Health Leader of the Year
awards.description: Awarded for leadership of the maternal health programme in West Africa.

awards.name: Chair's Award
awards.description: Awarded for the response to the 2015 winter floods.
